questions.q:
In a certain code language, 'tour hill peak valley' is written as 'cd jb mv kl', 'sand sea shore' is written as 'tr xz qw', 'peak sea tour' is written as 'mv tr kl' and 'sea sand valley' is written as 'jb tr qw'. What is the code for 'hill sea' in the same language?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'tour hill peak valley' को 'cd jb mv kl', 'sand seashore' को 'tr xz qw', 'peak sea tour' को 'mv tr kl' और 'sea sand valley' को 'jb tr qw' लिखा जाता है। उसी भाषा में 'hill sea' का कोड क्या है?
questions.s:
It is given that,

'tour hill peak valley' is written as 'cd jb mv kl'------(I)

'sand sea shore' is written as 'tr xz qw'-----(II)

'peak sea tour' is written as 'mv tr kl' -----(III)

'sea sand valley' is written as 'jb tr qw' -----(IV)

From (II) and (III), the code for 'sea' is tr.

From (I) and (III), the code for 'tour peak' is kl mv (in any order).

From (I) and (IV), the code for 'valley' is jb.

So, the remaining code i.e., 'cd' will be the code for hill.

Thus, 'hill sea' is coded as 'cd tr' (in any order).
